import trimesh, numpy as np
m=trimesh.load("exports/model.arm_upper.6773311f.stl")
print(m.bounds)
for name,box in [
 ("latch_lip",[[99.5,5.5,5.9],[101.5,6.5,6.3]]),
 ("thumb_tab",[[109.0,7.0,1.2],[114.0,13.0,2.0]]),
 ("latch_tower",[[102.5,10.0,3.8],[105.5,14.0,5.0]]),
]:
    lo=np.array(box[0],float); hi=np.array(box[1],float)
    xs=np.linspace(lo[0],hi[0],10); ys=np.linspace(lo[1],hi[1],8); zs=np.linspace(lo[2],hi[2],5)
    pts=np.array(np.meshgrid(xs,ys,zs)).reshape(3,-1).T
    print(name, m.contains(pts).mean())
# check exact geometry extents
print("vol",m.volume)
